text: The degree [K:F] of a field extension K/F is defined as:
choices: the number of roots of the minimal polynomial
dimₐ(K) — the dimension of K as an F-vector space
the degree of the minimal polynomial of a generator
explanation: [K:F] = dimₐ(K). Tower law: [K:F]=[K:L][L:F] for intermediate field L. Finite Galois extensions satisfy [K:F]=|Gal(K/F)|.
